lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular spots arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill slits, with approximately equidistant horizontal and vertical spacing between local maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots, forming a grid where spots serve as primary nodal points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition from light on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a significantly higher density of smaller, irregularly spaced high-luminance spots across its visible surface compared to the lateral flank pattern.
